mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_asset_usage (asset_id, used_in, reference_id, reference_table) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{usedIn}, #{referenceId}, #{referenceTable}) ON CONFLICT (asset_id, used_in, reference_id, reference_table) DO UPDATE SET removed_at = NULL, used_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM media_asset_usage WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY used_at
